english.meaning: by all means; used to stress a warning or a must-do
english.note: Usually in 千祈唔好, meaning don't ever.

exampleSentences.english: Whatever you do, don’t go to Wan Chai. Otherwise, Elton.
exampleSentences.traditional: 千祈唔好去灣仔區喎。費事就阿艾爾頓。

exampleSentences.english: Don’t fold it up thinking it’ll be easy.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你千祈唔好摺咗佢諗住易躉啊。
